content.text: Look at the photo. Read the first 16 lines of docs/MODEL.md with read_project_record. Then return JSON with the actual first-line title, exact source citation, requested_line_count 16, note null, and observed: the pictured object, clouds_visible, street_sign_visible.

street_sign_visible.description: True only if a street sign is actually visible; do not invent one.

function.name: read_project_record
function.description: Read actual project documentation lines; use the returned citation verbatim.
